title: Trade immediate scalar payload against information for unknown future tasks
statement: For the whole symmetric prior S=S0+H, ||H||op<=R, R>0, and symmetric task tr(T*S), a genuine programmable scalar channel(q,v)->v^T*S*q+e with ||q||,||v||<=1 and |e|<=eta has exact deterministic k-call radius eta*||T||_*+(R-eta)*tail_k(T) for0<=eta<=R. Here tail_k omits the k largest positive and k largest negative magnitudes separately; eta>=R leaves prior radius R*||T||_*. This matches k full-vector actions under their Euclidean error budget, returns k rather than k*n numbers, and can lose later-task information. The scalar instrument needs its own actual calibration.

requires: A genuinely available unit-bounded independently programmable scalar input/readout pair with its own |e|<=eta calibration and the whole supplied symmetric ball.
One known late task for the precision equality; the universal recovery count additionally uses noiseless exact observations and an open symmetric source class.
provides: For the whole symmetric prior S=S0+H, ||H||op<=R, R>0, and symmetric task tr(T*S), a genuine programmable scalar channel(q,v)->v^T*S*q+e with ||q||,||v||<=1 and |e|<=eta has exact deterministic k-call radius eta*||T||_*+(R-eta)*tail_k(T) for0<=eta<=R. Here tail_k omits the k largest positive and k largest negative magnitudes separately; eta>=R leaves prior radius R*||T||_*. This matches k full-vector actions under their Euclidean error budget, returns k rather than k*n numbers, and can lose later-task information. The scalar instrument needs its own actual calibration.
assumptions: Postprocessing a full vector already measured does not save native scalar bandwidth or acquire this detector. More scalar freedom/known formulas/correlated error restrictions change the comparison.
Equal immediate task risk does not imply equal retained off-task information, equal physical time/energy or a lifetime learning advantage.
costs: Charge both q and v preparation, native detector/noise calibration, scalar returns, arithmetic and any later reacquisition. Equally informed retaining controllers can choose the same interface and tie.
contract.units: eta is the actual scalar-channel absolute-error budget; beta_j carries decoder/task scaling. Native calls, returned numbers and future uncertainty are separate counts/units.
contract.obstruction: Specify actual detector capability and future-task objective before claiming measurement compression is an unconditional improvement.

body: Normalize the vector-optimal y_j as beta_j*v_j, beta_j=||y_j||, and use beta-weighted scalar reports; the tail/noise certificate is unchanged. A full-vector oracle can simulate any such scalar policy by projection, so the full-vector lower bound applies, proving equality. For T1=diag(1,-1), q=(e0+e1)/sqrt2 and v=(e0-e1)/sqrt2, positive Splus/minus=(2+/-R)*I with0<R<2 give the same exact scalar0. The late task T2=q*q^T differs by2R, whereas the corresponding full-vector old reading determines it at zero new calls. With an open symmetric source ball and noiseless data, universal exact recovery of every future task needs n*(n+1)/2 scalar bilinear calls versus n basis-vector calls returning n^2 coordinates. Central-transcript null directions give the deterministic adaptive scalar lower bound. Bandwidth, call count and future usefulness are different resources; neither interface universally dominates.
